messages:
alex: Heads-up — cutover for Private/VPC onprem release TOMORROW 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC. Need final signoffs: artifacts, cosign key, installer image pins, airgap bundle, release notes, rollback plan.

sam: Acknowledge. I'm on artifacts. Build completed on CI: s3://redwood-release/private/v1.4.3/artifacts.tar.gz sha256:3f2b7c... (initial). Will re-run checksum after packaging.

jess: I'll validate cosign signatures and rotation. Current key version: prod-key-v3. Will run cosign verify and post results.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC by @alex. Approval required from: sam, jess, maria. Use /deploy approve to confirm.

maria: Docs + RBAC checklist done. Confirmed installer script uses --offline-compat flag and includes KMS/HSM notes.

sam: Uploaded image manifests and shrinkwrap to staging registry: gcr.io/redwood/private:v1.4.3-shrinkwrap. Pushed to staging.

jess: Cosign verify output attached:
```bash
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/prod-key-v3 gcr.io/redwood/private:v1.4.3
# Verified OK
```
No mismatches on images.

kai: Quick QA note: the configmap migration needs a preflight check, otherwise upgrade path breaks on older clusters. Adding preflight hook to the installer (will open PR).

alex: Good catch @kai. Add a short rollback procedure to release notes: restore previous image tag v1.4.2 and run migration rollback script.

sam: Rollback script added at scripts/rollback_v1.4.3.sh in the release artifacts. Local tests passed.

maria: Release notes drafted at docs/releases/v1.4.3.md — includes breaking changes, manual on-prem steps, and the rollback procedure.

deploy-bot: Bot check: artifacts checksum mismatch reported for artifacts/installer.zip. CI artifact link: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234/logs. Please re-upload corrected artifact.

sam: Investigating checksum mismatch. Rebuilding installer zip now and will re-run cosign for images.

sam: Rebuilt and re-uploaded. New checksum sha256:8d9a4e... All artifacts verified.

deploy-bot: Deploy window update — go/no-go check scheduled at 09:30 UTC. Auto-rollback policy: if health score < 95% for 5m after startup, rollback to v1.4.2 automatically.

jess: Recommend we pin images in installer to exact digests to avoid transient tag resolution issues. Confirmed digests are present in the manifest.

alex: Final ask — please post final approvals with /deploy approve so deploy-bot can proceed. Also please :thumbsup: on the release notes PR when you review.

sam: /deploy approve

jess: /deploy approve

maria: /deploy approve

deploy-bot: All approvals received. Release scheduled for 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC. Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m verification windows. Post any urgent issues in #incidents.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll lead the cutover. We'll run post-deploy smoke at 10:15 UTC and call meeting if anything fails. Ping me directly for blockers.
